//site: shop.amul.com is a Vue SPA over a JSON API. browsePath is the page loaded first for the session cookie + serverTimestamp; category is the products filter. storeId is a site constant (not a secret) used to sign each API request: it comes from /ms/store/amul/auto/EN/storeinfo.js ("storeId"). That file is 190 KB, so it is not fetched every run. If every API call starts failing with HTTP 401 or 503, look it up again there.
//location: Stock is per pincode. The pincode maps to a substore (700032 -> west-bengal) whose stock the check reads. It is a city-level area, not a secret.
//products: A product is watched if its name contains any of these (case-insensitive). 'whey protein' covers all six whey SKUs (plain + chocolate, 30/60 sachets, both gift packs). A pattern that matches nothing is logged and shown in the daily check-in; it never alerts.
//notify: Your ntfy topic is SECRET (it is the only password on free ntfy.sh) -> set NTFY_TOPIC in the .env file, NOT here. Optionally override the server with NTFY_SERVER.

notify.//remindEveryMinutes: While a watched item stays in stock, push a high-priority reminder at most this often.
notify.//dailyHour: Send one quiet (min priority) check-in push per day at/after this hour (local time; set TZ in docker-compose). It is the proof-of-life heartbeat. -1 disables.
notify.//failureAlertHours: If every check fails for this long, push one warning (reset on the next good check).

//watch: After each check the tracker writes next-run (unix seconds) = now + intervalMinutes +/- jitterSeconds, and run-loop.sh sleeps until then. Whey sells out within the hour; one check is ~20 KB, so 5 minutes is still polite.
